default.impact_line: Messages sent through the EU region are failing.
default.impact_headline: Sending is failing in the EU region
default.summary: Requests to the EU sending endpoint are returning 500s. We have confirmed the failure is limited to that region and are rolling back a change released at 13:30. The rollback is running now.
default.affected_text: The EU sending endpoint, and every send that was due to leave it since 13:42. Those sends are queued, not dropped.
default.unaffected_text: The US region, the dashboard, webhooks, and everything already delivered. No data has been lost.

degraded-single-service.impact_line: Search results are up to ten minutes behind.
degraded-single-service.summary: The search index is rebuilding after a schema change, so a record you save now may not appear in search for up to ten minutes. Nothing is failing and nothing is being lost — the index is simply behind. We do not yet know why the rebuild is running this slowly.
degraded-single-service.affected_text: Search, and anything that reads from it: saved views, and the record picker.
degraded-single-service.unaffected_text: Everything else, including the API, exports and reporting, which read the database directly.
degraded-single-service.next_update_note: and then hourly until the index has caught up.
degraded-single-service.closing: If a specific record is missing from search and you need it found now, reply with the record id and we will look it up directly.
